about: Details of every /api/* route in routes.json, used by openapi.py to build docs/api/openapi.json (spec 028). Routes, methods and auth come from routes.json; response documents reference the contract schemas in specs/016-demo-device-emulation/contracts/schemas by file name. 'action' means the shared action-result schema.

tags.name: Safety
tags.description: The SafetyMonitor verdict and its history.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Read and change the device's settings.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Alerts: whether they're sent, recent ones, tests.

GET /api/status.description: Firmware, memory, flash, time, WiFi (with IPv6 addresses), MQTT, Bluetooth, darkness, alerts, Alpaca clients, connections, sensor health and diagnostics. Also pushed over `/ws/status`.

GET /api/sensors.description: Every reading, with each group's `status` (`ok`, `stale`, `missing`, `error`). The same document as `/ws/sensors` and MQTT `<base>/state`. Groups for switched-off sensors are left out.

GET /api/safe.description: Plain text `1` (safe) or `0` (unsafe): the SafetyMonitor verdict, for scripts and loggers.

GET /api/safety.description: The verdict served to Alpaca clients as `IsSafe`, with the reasons and the safe-delay countdown. Key on `safe` and `reasonFlags`; `reasons` is English text that may be reworded.

GET /api/safety/history.description: The last 32 safety changes, device restarts and safe/unsafe alerts, newest first. Survives software restarts, crashes and updates, not power cuts.

GET /api/settings/effective.description: Each setting that depends on another, and whether it's in effect or inactive, with the reason (spec 020).

GET /api/config.description: Every setting. Passwords and keys are masked.

POST /api/config.description: Partial update: only the fields sent change. A masked or empty password keeps the stored one; `null` clears it. A wrong value is refused with `error` naming it; a setting whose dependency is off is saved and reported inactive by `/api/settings/effective`.

PUT /api/config.description: The same as `POST /api/config`, for clients that use PUT.

POST /api/sensors/tsl2591/calibrate-dark.summary: Calibrate a sky sensor's dark offset
POST /api/sensors/tsl2591/calibrate-dark.description: Stores the current rolling visible count as the dark offset of one sky sensor (`sensor`, default the SQM) and writes only that sensor's calibration (`skyCalibration` or `skyCalibrationL`). Cover the sensor first and wait for the averaging window to fill. The answer names the `sensor`. 400 for an unknown `sensor`; 409 while it can't give a good offset (sensor off or not found, no readings yet, not in night mode, window not full).

parameters.name: sensor
parameters.description: `sqm` (default, the wide sensor on I2C-1) or `sqml` (the narrow SQM-L on I2C-2).

POST /api/sensors/rg15/test.description: Reads the RG-15 now and returns serial diagnostics. 409 when the rain sensor is switched off; 502 with a wiring `hint` when it doesn't answer.

POST /api/sensors/rg15/reset-total.description: Sends the RG-15 its `O` command (reset total accumulation).

GET /api/wifi/scan.description: The first call starts a background scan and answers 202 with `scanning: true`; call again about once a second until `scanning` is false and the list arrives.

POST /api/wifi/connect.description: What the WiFi setup screen uses. Answers 202 at once; poll `/api/status` (`wifi.connectPending`, then `wifi.connected`). On success the network is saved and the device restarts onto it 15 s later. Send `""` as the password for an open network.

POST /api/mqtt/test.description: Tries to connect with the given details without saving them. A `password` of `********` (the mask settings return) or empty means the saved password, which is only used when broker, port and username match the saved ones; for any other broker a masked password is refused with 400.

POST /api/update.description: A firmware `.bin` for this device's build and partition layout. 400 when the file is for another layout or build (nothing changed); 500 keeps the running firmware. The device restarts on success.

POST /api/update/fs.description: A LittleFS image that fills the web UI partition exactly. A file for another layout is refused before anything is erased. Settings are kept.

GET /api/updates/check.description: GitHub releases on the chosen track that have both files this device needs. 502 when GitHub can't be reached (a dropped connection is retried once); 409 while another check runs.

POST /api/updates/apply.description: Downloads and flashes a release from `check` in the background. Progress is pushed over `/ws/status` as `{"type":"ota_progress","progress":N}`; the device restarts when both files are flashed.

GET /api/alerts/armed.description: Whether alerts are being sent, the send mode and why it's sending or paused.

POST /api/alerts/arm.description: Takes effect at once and survives restarts.

POST /api/alerts/disarm.description: While paused nothing is sent and paired phones don't ring. Takes effect at once and survives restarts.

GET /api/alerts/recent.description: Whether alerts are on, and the last 20 since boot, newest first, with each channel's delivery result (`pending`, `sent`, `failed`, `skipped`).

POST /api/alerts/test.description: Queues a test on the given saved, switched-on channel(s); see `/api/alerts/recent` for the result. A channel that can't deliver right now is recorded as `skipped`. Add `event`, `level` and `sound` for a sample of that event, or `title`/`message` to try custom wording with `{variables}`.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: 1 quiet, 2 normal, 3 urgent, 4 wake me (also rings paired phones).

GET /api/i18n.description: The chosen language and whether its file is installed, downloading, restoring or failed.

POST /api/i18n/install.description: Downloads the chosen language's file for this firmware from GitHub. 409 when the language is English, or an update or another download is running.

POST /api/i18n/upload.description: Stores a language file by hand, for devices without internet. Answers with the `/api/i18n` document; 400 for a file that isn't gzip, is over 64 KB or doesn't fit.

POST /api/ble/ack.description: As if a phone had. 409 if no alarm is ringing.

POST /api/ble/forget-bonds.description: Phones need to pair again (with the passkey) to get alarms. 409 if Bluetooth is off.
